tenantId.description: Short lowercase identifier, used as the Terraform naming prefix (local.prefix) and backend-config key.

azureSubscriptionId.description: The tenant's dedicated Azure subscription GUID. One subscription per tenant — see architecture recommendation 1.

isolationModel.description: Fixed to dedicated-subscription per the platform's isolation decision; kept as an explicit field rather than an assumption so it is auditable per tenant.

dataResidency.description: ISO country/region code data must not leave, e.g. AU.

keyVaultName.description: Derived as kv-{tenantId}-{environment} if omitted; present here for explicitness in audits.

regulatoryClassification.description: Applicable regimes, e.g. APRA-CPS234, ASIC-RG271, AUSTRAC, CDR.

owner.description: Accountable individual or team for this tenant's lifecycle.

retirementPolicy.description: Plain-language decommission path, e.g. '90-day soft-decommission, then subscription cancellation'.
